input: Build a monthly cash envelope system for spending

gold.taskTitle: Build a Monthly Cash Envelope Spending System
gold.taskDescription: Set up a working cash envelope budgeting system to manage and control monthly spending across categories.

questions.title: What is your total monthly take-home income?
questions.description: Understanding the exact amount available each month is the foundation for allocating cash across envelopes.

questions.title: Which spending categories do you want envelopes for?
questions.description: Identifying the specific categories (e.g. groceries, dining, gas, entertainment) determines how many envelopes are needed.

questions.title: Will you use physical cash envelopes or a digital version?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user wants literal paper envelopes or a digital/app-based alternative shapes the entire setup approach.

questions.title: Do you already have a rough budget or starting from scratch?
questions.description: Determining whether existing spending data or a budget is available helps decide how much research and tracking setup is needed first.

questions.title: What day of the month do you get paid?
questions.description: The pay date anchors when envelopes are refilled and how the monthly cycle is structured.

questions.title: Are there fixed bills you want to exclude from the envelopes?
questions.description: Identifying bills like rent, utilities, or subscriptions that are paid automatically helps isolate only the discretionary spending the envelopes will cover.

questions.title: What is the main spending problem you are trying to solve?
questions.description: Understanding the core pain point (overspending, lack of visibility, impulse buying, etc.) ensures the system is designed to fix the right issue.
